propositions: A self-contained standard rebar MCP HTTP server must be deployed on the AWS box (Gerrit + review-bot + opcert) to enable copilot, codex, and claude clients to drive all rebar operations through it
The MCP server must use nginx /mcp/ TLS edge routing to loopback-bound HTTP with static bearer PAT authentication, not OAuth or SigV4 patterns

The MCP autodeploy mechanism must use blue-green immutable-release (atomic upstream pointer swap + retire-when-idle) rather than review-bot's stop-and-drain, to avoid saturating drain gates and killing in-flight certified operations
Per-client bearer PATs must be SSM-materialized as-code in terraform (rebar_secret_params set) and gitignored, never committed to the repository

The MCP server must sign certified plan-review and completion-verifier operations under the existing opcert environment (env_id 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65), with code-review remaining the Gerrit LLM-Review vote (not a new op-cert kind)
Copilot, codex, and claude must be configured with static-bearer credentials and verified to execute basic rebar read commands against the live AWS endpoint
